about_the_game:
I Love Click is a visually driven adult clicker game, focused on delivering a satisfying and seductive experience through stylish characters and a growing collection of sensual scenes.


Each girl is presented in a variety of poses, outfits, and moods, offering a layered experience for those who enjoy progressive discovery and visual variation. As you click and interact, new images and expressions are unlocked, adding depth and excitement to each encounter.


With a clean interface and smooth progression, I Love Click offers a polished, focused experience designed to reward curiosity and attention.

Key Features:


  • Dozens of carefully crafted CGs with variations in pose and expression

  • Simple click-based progression tied to visual unlocks

  • A strong visual identity with consistent character presentation

  • Unlockable gallery for completed scenes and replays

  • Lightweight, intuitive interface made for fast and fluid interaction

Main Characters:


  • Alice, 22, blonde programmer from New York, USA. She enjoys coding, indie games, and coffee. Currently studying Computer Science.

  • Jess, 23, cybersecurity specialist from London, UK. Passionate about hacking challenges, cyber law, and rock music. Studying Information Security.

  • Yumi, 22, cosplayer from Tokyo, Japan. Loves anime, manga, and photography. Attending Art School focusing on Visual Design.

  • Violet, 25, barista from Saint Petersburg, Russia. Interested in coffee culture, literature, and contemporary art. Studying Cultural Studies.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are adults. They work and have detailed individual characteristics such as age, birthdate, nationality, etc., available on the game store page. The story is set in a workplace environment and unfolds sometimes into old age. There are various events where sexual interactions between characters may occur, including vaginal, anal, and multiple positions.

Content Warning:

The game contains explicit representations of sexual acts, including vaginal and anal intercourse, as well as various sexual positions. There are also mature themes related to adult relationships within a professional setting.

Players should be aware that the game may contain content that is sensitive or triggering, such as:

Representations of sexual acts and nudity.
Potentially explicit language.

Please refer to the official website for detailed information about character backgrounds and other content warnings.
